meta.title: belote.gg — Play Belote Online | Ranked ELO Ladder
meta.description: Play belote online on a real ELO ladder. Ranked seasons, declarations and tricks scored for you, private tables for your friends, and an AI opponent offline. Web, iOS and Android.

hero.sub: Play ranked on a real ELO ladder. Bring your regular four—or queue up and find a table.
hero.caption: hero shot — ranked table, mid-hand

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.promo: Your rating is exactly where you left it.
signIn.heading: Welcome back
signIn.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
signIn.guestNote: Guest games are unranked and aren't saved.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.heading: Create your account
signUp.perksHeading: What you get with an account
perks: A rating that moves both ways, season after season.
Every game saved, with declarations and tricks scored for you.
Private tables you can reopen with the same four players.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter the email on your account and we’ll send you a reset link. It expires after one hour.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.heading: Check your email
checkEmail.bodyRest: has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your spam folder if it doesn’t show up.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.heading: Set a new password
reset.body: Saving this will sign you out on every other device.
reset.label: New password

twoFactor.title: Two-factor code
twoFactor.heading: Enter your code
twoFactor.body: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app. We only ask for it on devices we don’t recognise.

username.title: Pick a username
username.heading: Choose a username
username.label: Username
username.hint: Shown on the leaderboard. You can change it once per season.
username.note: Your rating appears after five placement games.

welcome.title: Account created
welcome.heading: You’re in,
welcome.body: Five placement games and you’ll have a rating. Join the queue on your own, or open a table and invite your usual three.

ranked.heading: Built for people who keep score
ranked.sub: Counting, signalling, nerve — all of it scored properly.

ladder.title: A ladder you can fall down
ladder.body: Win and you climb. Lose and you drop. Every season resets.

leaderboard.caption: screenshot — leaderboard / season standings
leaderboard.heading: Everyone at your table thinks they’re the best.
leaderboard.sub: One rating. One leaderboard. Every game on the record.

closing.heading: Take a seat.
closing.sub: Five placement games and you’re on the ladder. You can be there tonight.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes. Belote.gg is free to play — no ads, and nothing to buy.

items.question: Do my friends need an account?
items.answer: No. Send them your table link and they can play as guests. Ranked games need an account.

items.question: What if someone disconnects?
items.answer: The AI takes their seat so the game can finish, and hands it back the moment they return.

items.question: Can I play offline?
items.answer: Ranked games need a connection. Offline, you can play against the AI.
